items.name: forme-foundation
items.title: Forme foundation
items.description: Design tokens, motion presets and the shared class-name helper every Forme component builds on.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: agent-code-workspace
items.title: Agent Code Workspace
items.description: A coding agent at work: the conversation with its step log and test run on the left, and on the right the changed files as streaming diffs and the new file being written. One view at a time on a phone.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: agent-composer
items.title: Agent Composer
items.description: The compact composer of an agent app: a rounded field with round controls flush inside, send that becomes stop in place, a light that runs round the edge while the agent works, and a status row beneath.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: agent-image-chat
items.title: Agent Image Chat
items.description: A chat that makes images: each prompt becomes a turn whose image holds its shape, ripples while it generates and sharpens in, with download, variations, stop and retry. Built from Message, MessageScroller, ImageGeneration and AgentComposer.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: agent-log
items.title: Agent Log
items.description: What an agent did, as a tree that draws itself: each step opens its own height, the guide strokes out to it, and nested results branch beneath. Pure CSS, so it is a server component.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: agent-research-chat
items.title: Agent Research Chat
items.description: A research agent that shows its working: a plan that ticks itself off, a log of sources branching in, an approval that pauses the run before it queries production, and an answer with inline citations.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: agent-thinking
items.title: Agent Thinking
items.description: The line above a chat composer while an agent works: a loader, the current activity under a sweep of light, an elapsed timer and a Stop button. Each new activity becomes a timed step you can unfold, and it finishes as “Worked for 14.2s”.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: app-shell
items.title: App Shell
items.description: The frame of an app: a sidebar of sections and nav items, a header bar, a page header and a scrolling content column. On narrow screens the sidebar becomes a sheet in a native modal dialog.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: auth
items.title: Auth
items.description: The parts every Forme sign-in page is built from: a field with a label-row action, a password input with a show toggle, provider buttons, the divider, a testimonial and a row of customer marks. The numbered auth blocks are layouts of these; install this one to build your own.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: auth-1
items.title: Sign in, split with image
items.description: A sign-in page with the form on one side and a framed image on the other: email or username, a password with a show toggle and a forgot link, then Google and Apple. The image steps aside on narrow screens.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: auth-2
items.title: Sign in, split with testimonials
items.description: A sign-in page beside a brand panel: a headline, a carousel of customer quotes and a rating line. The form takes email or username and a password, with Google, Apple and GitHub underneath and a small footer of links.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: A marketing hero with an eyebrow, a headline, a supporting paragraph, two calls to action and a frame for a real product screenshot. Every part is composed by you, so the section carries your copy instead of a placeholder.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: infinite-masonry
items.title: Infinite Masonry
items.description: An endless photo feed in balanced columns. Tiles reserve their space from the image size, so nothing shifts as pages arrive; the next page loads as the shortest column nears view; and it is an ARIA feed with Page Down between items. No virtualiser, no dependencies.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: A pricing section with three tiers, a monthly and annual toggle the caller controls, and a featured tier marked by a stronger border and a small label rather than a coloured card. Each tier takes its own price, so the toggle is a few lines of your own state.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: transcript-player
items.title: Transcript Player
items.description: A recording and its transcript as one surface: the line and word being spoken are marked as it plays, and a click on any line or word seeks there. Takes WhisperX output as it comes.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Collapsible sections on the Base UI primitive, with headings a screen reader can list, arrow-key navigation between triggers and a height that animates to the measured content.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline message in four states, with a matching icon, an optional title and room for an action. Only the destructive state interrupts a screen reader; the rest wait their turn.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: area-chart
items.title: Area Chart
items.description: A line or area chart in plain SVG with no chart library. A crosshair snaps to the nearest point and lists every series, arrow keys walk it, round tick values, a legend from two series up, and a hidden table so screen readers get the numbers.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: audio-player
items.title: Audio Player
items.description: A transport bar for one recording: skip back and forward, play, a seek bar, time, volume and speed. Its ref is a small handle, so a transcript or a chapter list can seek and play it from outside.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: audio-player-chapters
items.title: Audio Player: Chapters
items.description: An episode with a chapter list: the starts become markers on the waveform, the current chapter fills as it plays, and any chapter seeks and plays.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: audio-player-keyboard
items.title: Audio Player: Keyboard shortcuts
items.description: Space, J, K, L, the arrows, M and the number keys, all through the player's handle, with each action confirmed as it happens.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: audio-player-plain-seek-bar
items.title: Audio Player: Plain seek bar
items.description: waveform={false}: a line instead of the recording's shape, and no download to draw it — the choice for long files.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: audio-player-volume-popover
items.title: Audio Player: Volume in a popover
items.description: volume="popover": the icon mutes and unmutes on click, and a slider opens above it on hover or focus.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: audio-player-bare
items.title: Audio Player: Bare
items.description: waveform, speed and volume all off: transport, seek and time only, with the device owning the volume.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: audio-player-now-playing
items.title: Audio Player: Now playing
items.description: A media card that reacts to playback through onPlayingChange, with the player cut to the essentials: a plain seek bar, no speed button and volume in a popover.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A user image with a fallback that shows initials while the image loads, and when it never arrives at all. Built on the Base UI avatar primitive, so the image and the fallback swap without a flash of empty space.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label for status, counts and metadata, in five quiet variants and two sizes. The colour lives in the tint so the text stays readable at eleven pixels, and an icon or a dot inside the badge carries the state at a glance.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar Chart
items.description: A single or grouped column chart in plain SVG. Columns are capped at 24px with rounded tops and 2px gaps, the hovered category lifts while the rest recede, arrow keys read each category, and a hidden table carries every value.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where a page sits in the hierarchy, as a labelled nav with an ordered list and the current page marked. Separators are drawn in CSS, so a screen reader hears the path and not the slashes.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The primary action element. Four variants and three sizes, gradient primaries that crossfade on hover rather than snap, and an icon contract where the button owns the icon size. No client boundary, so it works in a server component and ships no JavaScript.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: A month grid for a single date or a range, with no date library. Full WAI-ARIA keyboard support, min, max and disabled days, a range that previews under the pointer, and a fixed six-week height so nothing below it jumps.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A bordered surface with a header, title, description, content and footer you compose yourself, so a card is never more structure than the content inside it needs. Everything reads from the foundation tokens, which makes it retheme with the rest of the library.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: The tooltip and legend every Forme chart shares: a floating panel with a colour, a name and a right-aligned value per series, and a row of swatches. Installed with any chart; use them directly to give a chart of your own the same finish.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.description: One turn of an AI conversation: a compact bubble for the person, full-width prose for the assistant, a streaming caret, and copy, regenerate and feedback actions that keyboard and touch can always reach.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: A single choice with a visible label wired to it for a screen reader. Carries a destructive variant for choices that cannot be undone, and the box itself fills with the accent when checked so the state is readable at a glance.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: citations
items.title: Citations
items.description: Sources for an AI answer: numbered inline markers that preview their source on hover or focus, and a Sources line with stacked favicons that opens into the numbered list.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: citations-sources-list
items.title: Citations: Answer with sources
items.description: A research answer with inline citations, a stack of favicons for how many places it drew on, and the full list beneath.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: Code an agent wrote or is writing: highlighted by a small built-in tokenizer in the theme's syntax colours, with line numbers, marked and diff lines, wrapping, a header with a title and actions, a small size for tool output, copy, and a view that follows streamed code until you scroll away.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: code-block-wrapped
items.title: Code Block: Wrapped lines
items.description: wrap: a long command with flags reads whole instead of scrolling sideways.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: code-block-explained
items.title: Code Block: Explained line by line
items.description: Notes beside the code; choosing one marks the lines it explains with highlightLines.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: code-block-diff
items.title: Code Block: Diff lines
items.description: diff reads the + and - markers into the gutter and tints added and removed lines.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: code-block-terminal
items.title: Code Block: Terminal output
items.description: A title and icon instead of a file name, and a Run again action beside copy.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command menu
items.description: A command palette opened with ⌘K or Ctrl K, with a search field, grouped items, keyword matching and an empty state. Built on cmdk for the filtering and the keyboard path, inside a Radix dialog for the focus trap.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: composed-chart
items.title: Composed Chart
items.description: Columns and a line on one axis, on TanStack Charts: volume against its target, actuals against the plan. Rounded columns side by side, the line drawn over them, and a band cursor that lists every series in the column.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: confirm-button
items.title: Confirm Button
items.description: A destructive button that grows into its own confirmation on a spring, so the question appears where you are looking. Focus lands on Cancel, Esc or clicking away disarms it, and the confirm button shows a spinner while the action runs.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A typed table with sortable headers, search, row selection with bulk actions and paging. Columns are data and every cell is yours to render. A sticky header, aria-sort, an indeterminate select-all, and a selection that survives sorting.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal built on the Base UI primitive, so the focus trap, the inert background, Esc to close and the return of focus all come from one well tested place. The backdrop fades and the panel scales in, both in and out, and everything comes from the foundation tokens.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: A macOS-style row of icons that swell under the pointer on a spring, with their neighbours growing too. Labels show on hover and focus, open apps get a dot, and reduced motion keeps every icon at its resting size.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: donut-chart
items.title: Donut Chart
items.description: Part of a whole as a ring with the total in the centre. The legend is a list of buttons with values and percentages, and hovering or tabbing through it lifts the slice and shows its value in the middle.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A bottom sheet on the Base UI dialog, so it keeps the focus trap, Esc and focus return. Drag it down by the handle or header and it follows your finger, then springs back or closes when pulled past a third of its height or flicked.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: dropdown
items.title: Dropdown
items.description: A menu of actions revealed from a trigger. Grouped, with labels, a destructive variant, checkbox items, and full keyboard and typeahead support from the Base UI menu primitive — Forme adds only the surface and the motion.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: dynamic-island
items.title: Dynamic Island
items.description: A black pill that morphs on a spring to fit whatever it is showing: a timer, a call, a song or a notification. Content swaps through a short blur crossfade, the corners never stretch mid-morph, and each change is announced politely.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: What a list, table or page shows before it has anything in it: a stacked icon, a title, one sentence and the next action. So an empty screen reads as a start rather than an error.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: feature-voting
items.title: Feature Voting
items.description: A list of feature requests to upvote, with a status for each. Votes land at once and roll the count; the list sorts by votes when it mounts and never under the pointer.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: file-diff
items.title: File Diff
items.description: A change to one file as an agent applies it: path, counts and a proportion bar in the header, highlighted added and removed lines below, following the newest line while it streams and folding away when done.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: file-diff-changeset
items.title: File Diff: Changeset to review
items.description: An agent's change across several files with the totals up top, the first file open, and keep or discard for the lot.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: file-diff-new-file
items.title: File Diff: New file
items.description: A file written from nothing: every line added as it streams in, then folded to its header once it is done.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: file-diff-deleted-file
items.title: File Diff: Deleted file
items.description: A file removed outright, every line on the old side, with a sentence above saying why.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: File Dropzone
items.description: A drop target that is also a real file picker, so click, keyboard and drag all work. Checks type and size on drop as well as in the picker, and reports each rejected file by name.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: file-dropzone-avatar
items.title: File Dropzone: Avatar
items.description: A round profile photo that is itself the drop target, with an instant preview, a remove button and the size limit under it.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: file-dropzone-compact
items.title: File Dropzone: Compact
items.description: One strip for a form: an Add files button, the picks as thumbnails beside it and a count against the limit.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: file-dropzone-gallery
items.title: File Dropzone: Gallery
items.description: A drop zone over an image grid, seeded with saved photos, with a running total and Clear all.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: file-dropzone-progress
items.title: File Dropzone: Upload queue
items.description: Each file as a card with its own progress bar, a retry when one fails, and counts of what is done, running and failed.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: file-dropzone-table
items.title: File Dropzone: Table
items.description: Documents in a table you drop straight onto, with a progress ring while each sends and download, retry and delete per row.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: file-dropzone-sortable
items.title: File Dropzone: Sortable
items.description: Listing photos you put in order by dragging a handle or with the arrow keys; the first one is the cover.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: file-dropzone-cover
items.title: File Dropzone: Cover image
items.description: A wide banner with Change and Remove over the photo, a percent ring while the new one uploads, and the image guidelines below.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: heatmap-chart
items.title: Heatmap Chart
items.description: A grid of cells whose colour carries a quantity, on TanStack Charts: activity by weekday and hour, scores by team and quarter. Six steps of one hue from the sunken surface to the chart accent, optional values in the cells, and a tooltip on every cell.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: histogram-chart
items.title: Histogram Chart
items.description: How a set of measurements is distributed, on TanStack Charts. Bins are computed with round edges, the tooltip names each range and its count, and dashed markers put a median or p95 right on the shape.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: hold-button
items.title: Hold Button
items.description: Press and hold to confirm, with a fill that sweeps across while you hold and drains back if you let go early. For actions too serious for one click and too small for a dialog. Space and Enter hold it from the keyboard.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: image-compare
items.title: Image Compare
items.description: Two images split by a divider you drag from anywhere on the image: before and after, design and build, light and dark. To assistive technology the divider is a real slider, with arrow, Page and Home/End keys.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: image-generation
items.title: Image Generation
items.description: An image an assistant is making: the frame keeps the image's shape from the start, a field of dots ripples while it generates, the image sharpens in through refining, and a failure offers to try again.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field with a real label, optional description, an error that is announced and wired up with aria-describedby, and room for an icon on either side. Sizes and the invalid state come from the same tokens as every other Forme surface.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key and a chord of keys, rendered as real kbd elements with a keycap edge. For shortcut hints in menus, tooltips and empty states.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: A photo gallery whose thumbnails fly into a full-screen viewer and back again. Arrow keys, a thumbnail strip and swipe move between photos, and it is a Base UI dialog underneath, so focus is trapped and returns to the thumbnail you opened.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: line-chart
items.title: Line Chart
items.description: One or more series over an ordered axis on TanStack Charts, as smooth lines or as areas that fade to their baseline. A dashed cursor snaps to the nearest x from anywhere in the plot, the tooltip lists every series there, and areas can stack.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: Eight loading indicators — ring, dots, bars, a dot-grid wave and orbit, a terminal braille spinner, a figure-eight comet and sparkles. Pure CSS in a server component, sized in em and coloured by currentColor, with a still frame under reduced motion.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: A seamless, endlessly scrolling row for logos, photos or testimonials. It pauses on hover and focus, screen readers hear the content once, and reduced motion turns it into a row you scroll by hand. Pure CSS.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Chat messages assembled from parts: avatar, header, bubble, footer, groups, markers, a typing indicator and a measured Show more. The side is set once and every part follows it, with no provider.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: message-scroller
items.title: Message Scroller
items.description: The scrolling transcript of a chat: it follows a streaming reply, lets go the moment you scroll up, and brings you back with a Jump to latest pill. An optional rail of ticks previews and jumps to any message.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: metal-button
items.title: Metal Button
items.description: A button with a chrome rim whose reflections travel slowly round it, and a glint that crosses the face on hover. Plain CSS in a server component, still for reduced motion.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: mic-selector
items.title: Mic Selector
items.description: A microphone picker that asks for permission first, so devices show by name rather than as blanks, then stays current as headsets are plugged in and out. Hands back a deviceId for getUserMedia.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: Choose several options from a long list: removable chips you can type into to filter, over a list where each option toggles. Groups, a max with a counter, Backspace and arrow keys through the chips, and plain form submission — on Base UI's Combobox.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: number-flow
items.title: Number Flow
items.description: A number whose digits roll like an odometer when it changes, so only the digits that changed move. Formatting comes from Intl, so currency signs and separators stay put, and screen readers hear the value once.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: A number that counts up when it scrolls into view and counts between values when it changes, formatted with Intl. Screen readers hear the final value once, and reduced motion skips the count.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time code field drawn as a box per character over one real input, so typing, paste, SMS autofill, Android keyboards and screen readers all just work. Overwrites in place, shakes on a wrong code, draws a check on a right one.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links rendered on the server, with the ends always reachable and a gap only where it hides more than one page. Previous and next hold their place on the first and last page, so nothing shifts as you click through.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: poll
items.title: Poll
items.description: A question to vote on that turns into its results in place: bars grow to each share, the percentages roll and always total 100, and your choice is marked. Single or multiple choice, on real radios and checkboxes.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A small surface anchored to a trigger, with a title and a description that Base UI wires into the accessibility tree so the popover is announced with a name. Collision-aware placement, portalled so it escapes overflow, and a Close part for the explicit way out.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: A determinate progress bar with its label and value, both announced to a screen reader by the Base UI parts rather than by hand-written aria attributes. A null value renders as indeterminate and dims the track so it reads as waiting.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt Input
items.description: The composer for an AI chat. Enter sends and Shift+Enter breaks a line without ever sending half an IME word. It grows with the text, takes pasted images as attachments, has a slot for model pickers and toggles, and its send button turns into stop while a reply streams.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: radar-chart
items.title: Radar Chart
items.description: Several measures on one shape for comparing a few profiles, on TanStack Charts. Every spoke shares one scale from zero, the grid is a polygon, and focus picks a whole spoke so the tooltip lists every profile on it.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: radial-bar-chart
items.title: Radial Bar Chart
items.description: Concentric rings that sweep round to their value over a faint track, on TanStack Charts: usage against plan limits, progress toward several goals. Rounded ends, an open middle, and every value printed in the legend.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: A choice of exactly one option, where the group owns the value and the arrow keys travel in the direction the options are laid out. Horizontal and vertical are the same component with an orientation, and a disabled option reads as present but unavailable.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: reasoning
items.title: Reasoning
items.description: A model's visible thinking that opens while it thinks and folds away when the answer arrives, with a live timer and a 'Thought for 4s' summary. Once the reader opens or closes it, it stays where they left it.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: scatter-chart
items.title: Scatter Chart
items.description: Two measures against each other, one dot per observation, on TanStack Charts. Groups take their own colour and legend entry, an optional dashed trend line fits each group, and focus finds the nearest point by pointer or arrow keys.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: A row of mutually exclusive options whose selected pill moves between them on a spring. It behaves as a radio group, with one tab stop and arrow keys that move the selection, and reduced motion turns the spring into a cut.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A choice from a list too long for radio buttons. Grouped with labels, an inline check on the selected option, typeahead and arrow-key navigation from the Base UI select primitive, and a trigger that reads as a field rather than as a button so it sits beside inputs without looking wrong.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between two things. Horizontal by default and vertical when rotated, with the vertical one stretching to fill the row it sits in so it works between buttons without a height being passed.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: shine-border
items.title: Shine Border
items.description: A border with light running around it, for the one card or call to action that should be found first. A meteor of light with a fading tail, in any shape, pill included. Pure CSS in a server component, and it holds still for reduced motion.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder shaped like the content that is loading, with a single travelling shimmer. Hidden from screen readers, so the loading region announces itself once.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A single or range slider on the Base UI primitive, with a label, a formatted value that matches what a screen reader announces, and a thumb that grows when picked up.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: sortable-list
items.title: Sortable List
items.description: A list you reorder by dragging a handle, or with the arrow keys once the handle has focus. The other rows move aside on a spring, the rest of each row stays free for text and links, and every keyboard move is announced with its new position.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A card lit by the pointer: a soft wash follows the cursor and the nearest stretch of border catches the light. Tracked through CSS variables, so it never re-renders, and keyboard focus inside lights it too.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: stacked-bar-chart
items.title: Stacked Bar Chart
items.description: Bars split into the parts that make them up, on TanStack Charts. Layers keep the order you give them in every bar, `percent` compares the mix instead of the totals, and focus groups a whole bar so the tooltip lists every layer.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A metric card with the value, a coloured change against the last period and a sparkline drawn as plain SVG on the server. Says which direction is good, so falling latency reads green.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Progress through a fixed sequence, horizontal or vertical, with complete, current and upcoming states and a connector that fills as you go. Collapses to vertical on narrow screens.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: suggestion-stack
items.title: Suggestion Stack
items.description: An agent's suggestions as a stack of cards, decided one at a time: apply or skip, or drag the card either way. The next ones peek out behind, and checks show as a split bar.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: A control for a setting that takes effect immediately, with a label wired to it for a screen reader. Optional on and off text inside the track, and the thumb travels on a single transform so the motion stays smooth.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs built on the Base UI primitive, so arrow keys, Home and End and the roving tab order come for free. The primitive measures the selected tab and publishes it as a CSS variable, so the underline glides without this component holding a single ref.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: task-list
items.title: Task List
items.description: An agent's plan and its progress: pending, running, done and failed tasks with a progress bar and a count. Built on Trace and stateless, so you pass the current tasks on each update, and each status is written out for screen readers.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: A headline that arrives word by word, by blur, rise or fade, the first time it scrolls into view. It plays once, the full sentence is in the accessible name from the start, and reduced motion shows the words straight away.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A labelled multi-line field that grows with its content using CSS alone, with help text, an error state and an optional character count that warns as you near the limit.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme Toggle
items.description: A sun that sets into a crescent moon, and the new theme revealed from the button with a View Transition: a circle, a soft-edged spill or a shutter, measured to the farthest corner. No theme library, no flash, and a setTheme you can call from anywhere.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A card that leans toward the pointer in 3D with a highlight sliding across it, then settles flat when the pointer leaves. It is driven by CSS variables with no re-renders, and it stays flat for touch and reduced motion.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: timeline
items.title: Timeline
items.description: An activity feed of events with a time, a status dot or a custom marker, and a rail that stops at the last item. For audit logs, deploy histories and notifications.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Stacked notifications you fire from anywhere with toast.success(), toast.error() or toast.promise(). They fan behind the newest one, expand on hover, take an undo action and swipe away. Mount one Toaster at the root.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle group
items.description: A row of toggles that share a value, or several. One control rather than a row of separate buttons: the selected one is filled and its neighbours stay quiet, and it works for icon-only formatting bars and for labelled density switches alike.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: tool-approval
items.title: Tool Approval
items.description: An agent asking before it acts: the question first, its arguments one click below, and Allow once, Always allow and Deny in a footer that folds away once answered, leaving a record of the outcome.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: tool-result
items.title: Tool Result
items.description: One agent tool call and its output: a Trace line that summarises what ran and how it went, over output that follows a running call and folds away when it finishes, with copy and run again.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: tool-result-retry
items.title: Tool Result: Failed, then retried
items.description: A request that times out shows its error and status, and Run again makes a second call that succeeds.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: tool-result-search-results
items.title: Tool Result: Custom result
items.description: A custom kind with its own icon and children: the documents a docs search returned, as links.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short description of a control, shown on hover and on keyboard focus, with an optional arrow. Built on the Base UI primitive and portalled so a tooltip is never clipped by the toolbar or table it belongs to.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: trace
items.title: Trace
items.description: The steps an agent takes, one line each: reasoning, tool calls, sources, plans and subagent runs. Every line has an icon, a title, a description and a status, sweeps while running, and can open its output, link away, open a dialog, or nest a whole Trace.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: trace-overlay
items.title: Trace: Lines that open a dialog
items.description: TraceRow asChild around a dialog trigger: a source opens its page in a dialog instead of expanding in place.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: trace-ai-sdk
items.title: Trace: From AI SDK message parts
items.description: One switch turns reasoning, tool and source parts from useChat into Trace lines, status included.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: transcript
items.title: Transcript
items.description: A transcript that follows the audio: the current line is marked and kept in view, the word being said lights within it, and any line or word seeks back to where it was spoken. One tab stop, arrow keys between lines.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: transcript-speakers
items.title: Transcript: Speakers
items.description: A diarised meeting: each line carries who said it, and a click marks the line — wire onSeek to a player to jump there.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: transcript-live-captions
items.title: Transcript: Live captions
items.description: Lines join as a streaming speech-to-text service finalises them, and the box keeps up with the newest one.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: voice-button
items.title: Voice Button
items.description: The record button of a voice interface: push to talk or tap to toggle, a live waveform and a running clock while recording, then transcribing, done or try again. You drive the state; it records nothing itself.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: voice-note
items.title: Voice Note
items.description: One entry in a list of voice notes: when it was recorded, what was said and the recording to check it against. While transcription runs it holds its place with a waveform and placeholder lines.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: voice-orb
items.title: Voice Orb
items.description: The presence of a voice assistant: a liquid WebGL sphere that drifts while idle, gathers light as you speak, stirs while thinking and ripples as it speaks. Painted from your theme tokens, and fed by a level or an AnalyserNode.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: voice-picker
items.title: Voice Picker
items.description: Choose a text-to-speech voice by ear: grouped voice cards in one radio group, each with a play button for a sample beside the radio, and a waveform on the one that is playing.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: waterfall-chart
items.title: Waterfall Chart
items.description: How a starting amount becomes a final one, on TanStack Charts: revenue bridged through new business and churn, a budget through its line items. Each change floats from where the last ended, gains and losses in their own hues, with a closing total.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: waveform
items.title: Waveform
items.description: A row of bars for anything that makes or hears sound. Loops on its own while listening or speaking, follows a level or an AnalyserNode's spectrum when given one, and sends a pulse across while thinking.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>

items.name: dashboard
items.title: Dashboard
items.description: A full application screen: navigation with a usage meter, a metric row with trends, a revenue chart with a range control, a channel bar list, a sortable invoice table with search and paging, and the payout schedule. Bring your data as props — every list and number is yours.
items.author: Forme UI <hello@formeui.com>
